name: Kaldheim
description: Kaldheim is a Norse-inspired plane of ten realms bound together by the World Tree, home to gods, giants, elves, dwarves and the dead.

description_citations.text: Kaldheim: card flavor text (Kaldheim, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Kaldheim is a Norse-inspired plane of ten realms bound together by the World Tree, home to gods, giants, elves, dwarves and the dead.

citations.text: Kaldheim: card flavor text (Kaldheim, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Kaldheim (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Skoti gods overthrew the Einir, who became the plane's elves, and the Skoti lost the relics that had sealed the demons in Immersturm.

citations.text: "Kaldheim (plane)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"List of deities", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Kaya visited Kaldheim and, with Tyvar Kell, exposed Tibalt, who had impersonated the god Valki, stolen the Sword of the Realms and brought on a Doomskar in which demons led by Varragoth attacked.

citations.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Halvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Kaya killed Varragoth by cutting his throat with one of Tyvar's axes, which ended the Doomskar.

citations.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Norn's orders Vorinclex came to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge, took a sample of tyrite, and stole a fragment of the World Tree's essence that became the Phyrexian Invasion Tree.

citations.text: "Plane", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Inga Rune-Eyes", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the ten realms collided, Harald and Tyvar led the defense, and Kaldheim's denizens burned the World Tree to deny Phyrexia access.

citations.text: "Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"World Tree", section "Burned down". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The World Tree later regrew and reconnected some realms, and Skemfar's elves renewed their challenge against the Skoti.

citations.text: "World Tree", section "Burned down". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Kaldheim survived the invasion with its World Tree regrown, and in the latest story Tyvar, who was desparked, is recruited there for the Duskmourn rescue.

citations.text: "World Tree", section "Burned down". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Tyvar Kell", section "Invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Ramaz on Kaldheim; he escapes, revealing he served a greater dragon.
timeline.quote: After a skirmish, he escaped, revealing that he had only been a minion in a yet greater scheme

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Tracking Ramaz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Angrath names the plane they saw as Kaldheim and explains freedom starts with knowing you are trapped.
timeline.quote: Kaldheim,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kaya rides Cosima's longship through the Cosmos and learns from Inga about Omenpaths and Doomskars.
timeline.quote: It was the Doomskars people feared, though—celestial collisions that seemed invariably to lead to calamity.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, narrating, boasts that his plotting will set Kaldheim ablaze, and tells the saga of a planeswalker named Tibalt.
timeline.quote: all of Kaldheim would be improved with a touch more fire, a dash of anarchy

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The Horrible Beast poisons Tibalt with a seed and forces him to cause a distraction, though Tibalt had already planned to stir up trouble.
timeline.quote: the Horrible Beast snuck up on him one day and stuck Tibalt with a nasty, tricky sort of poison

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tricks Valki, the God of Lies, to use him as a disguise.
timeline.quote: It happened that this God of Lies, this Prince of Tricksters, was foolish enough to get lied to and tricked himself.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Disguised as Valki, Tibalt visits Koll the Forgemaster, who refuses to hand over the Sword of the Realms, and pushes him into his forge.
timeline.quote: so Tibalt did the realms a favor and pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt stirs trouble in Surtland and Bretagard, warning frost giants of trolls and promising the Skelle the return of Varragoth.
timeline.quote: Tibalt sowed the seeds of war and chaos

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Kaya visits Kaldheim, a world of prophecy and legend.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Kaya visits a world of prophecy and legend

citation.text: "Kaldheim", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A weapon of pure strength, forged for a god, may become one of unimaginable chaos in other hands.
timeline.quote: A weapon with the ability to protect all .

citation.text: "Kaldheim", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Einir gods, who ruled the realms, are replaced by the Skoti pantheon and become the plane's elves.
timeline.quote: The defeated Einir became the plane's elves .

citation.text: "Kaldheim (plane)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Two Kaldheim Commander decks are released together with Kaldheim as on-ramps to Commander.
timeline.quote: Two Kaldheim Commander decks are released together with Kaldheim .

citation.text: "Kaldheim/Commander". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya exposes Tibalt behind the troll gathering and escapes with Tyvar's help.
timeline.quote: She quickly saw through the disguise and revealed the planeswalker Tibalt doing his dirty work

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Skoti supplant the Einir as Kaldheim's ruling gods.
timeline.quote: supplanted the ancient Einir a few centuries ago

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Skoti defeat the Einir, losing the relics that sealed the demons in Immersturm.
timeline.quote: When the Skoti challenged the Einir's supremacy and defeated them, these relics were lost.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko loses their spark and is trapped on Kaldheim after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: only to be trapped there in its aftermath when they lost their spark .

citation.text: "Niko Aris", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bridge sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim to obtain Tyrite and brings him back to New Phyrexia, burning off his organic parts each way.
timeline.quote: The Planar Bridge was used to transport the praetor Vorinclex to the plane of Kaldheim to obtain a sample of Tyrite

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex ambushes Tibalt, infects him with phyresis and holds him hostage.
timeline.quote: Tibalt was ambushed by Vorinclex , who infected him with phyresis

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, advises King Harald to prepare for war; Tyvar grows suspicious and investigates.
timeline.quote: Suspicious of this "Valki", Tyvar began to follow and investigate the god through the realms.

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar rescues Kaya at Gnottvold by turning the Torga trolls to stone, and they decide to stop Tibalt together.
timeline.quote: The elf helped Kaya by defeating the trolls, turning them into stone.

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar and thousands of demons led by Varragoth stream through a rift to attack another realm.
timeline.quote: they were unable to prevent Tibalt from creating a Doomskar

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar, Kaya and Arni fly toward Halvar with the Sword of the Realms but are attacked by Varragoth and fall near the Dread Marn.
timeline.quote: were attacked in midair by the demon Varragoth who wanted the Sword for himself

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya cuts Varragoth's throat with one of Tyvar's axes, ending the Doomskar; Tyvar resolves to walk the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: the demon was only stopped by Kaya, who cut the demon's throat with one of the axes Tyvar had made for her

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex is sent to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge on Norn's orders; the process destroys his body and he rebuilds himself.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex was sent to Kaldheim through the Planar Bridge on Norn's orders.

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex infects Tibalt, forcing him to cause a distraction in exchange for an antidote.
timeline.quote: he ambushed the planeswalker Tibalt and infected him

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex mauls Esika to near death, takes a tyrite sample and returns to New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex invaded the sanctum of Esika and mauled her to near death.

citation.text: "Vorinclex", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: King Narfi betrays his people and leads the god of death to transform Karfell's nobles and subjects into undead draugr.
timeline.quote: King Narfi betrayed his people and led the god of death to transform all Karfell's nobles and their subjects into undead.

citation.text: "Zombie", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex retrieves a tyrite sample from Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: they sent Vorinclex , who successfully fulfilled his mission and retrieved a sample

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex infects Tibalt with a seed.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex also infected Tibalt with a "seed", wounded the god Esika

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Forays to other planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex invades Kaldheim and is confronted by Kaya, Alrund and the Omenseekers; he wounds Esika and leaves with a tyrite sample.
timeline.quote: he fought and wounded the god Esika before leaving Kaldheim with a sample of tyrite

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Vorinclex on Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim for a sample of tyrite.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn sent Vorinclex to the plane of Keldheim to retrieve a sample of tyrite

citation.text: "Plane", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The fleet passes through the Cosmos and flies toward the Invasion Tree with valkyries.
timeline.quote: Valkyries fly alongside them toward the sharp barbs of the Invasion Tree

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian serpent rises from the sea, snapping longships, and Tyvar leaps into its mouth.
timeline.quote: Tyvar leaps from the ship.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: On Kaldheim, Harald counts the minutes until his brother Tyvar bursts from the sea clinging to a serpent's head.
timeline.quote: On the count of three hundred thirteen, Tyvar Kell bursts from the water clinging to the serpent's engorged head.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaldheim's corrupted World Tree essence becomes the seed of New Phyrexia's Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: The corrupted essence of Kaldheim's World Tree became the seed from which New Phyrexia's Realmbreaker grew.

citation.text: Ichor Elixir (March of the Machine Commander, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR Kaldheim mobilizes against the growing New Phyrexian threat.
timeline.quote: In 4562 AR , the plane mobilized against the growing New Phyrexian threat.

citation.text: "Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the invasion the ten realms collide and Harald and Tyvar Kell lead the defense.
timeline.quote: the ten realms collided, connecting Kaldheim as one plane

citation.text: "Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaldheim's denizens burn the World Tree to deny the Phyrexians access.
timeline.quote: Kaldheim's denizens burned the tree

citation.text: "Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion Skemfar's elves renew their challenge against the Skoti.
timeline.quote: Skemfar's elves have renewed their challenge against the Skoti.

citation.text: "Kaldheim (plane)", section "Phyrexia invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Harald lead the defense of Skemfar and Kaldheim; Tyvar slays a Phyrexian serpent and is desparked in the Great Desparkening.
timeline.quote: Tyvar was desparked in the Great Desparkening

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Invasion of the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Kaldheim, Tyvar fights a lone wolf and knocks it back with a stone-fisted punch.
timeline.quote: The wolf, which was easily twice his size, leapt, and Tyvar swung a mighty left hook at the soft underside of its jaw

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds Tyvar and recruits him for the rescue; Tyvar eagerly agrees.
timeline.quote: When do we leave?

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Tyvar vouches for Niko Aris, a former planeswalker, as the defensive fighter Kaito needs.
timeline.quote: I think I may have just the hero that you need

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko splits Trygve's thrown axe, and then their own, with two throws.
timeline.quote: The first struck the handle of Trygve's axe, splitting it lengthwise.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Niko shows their shard magic, says the invasion did not take it, and agrees to come along.
timeline.quote: Can't let the Planeswalkers have all the fun.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Helle takes her place among the honored host after learning one thousand tales.
timeline.quote: she'd finally taken her place among the honored host.

citation.text: Youthful Valkyrie (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alrund undertakes a quest to become the wisest being, taking secrets from each Cosmos monster as it submits over centuries.
timeline.quote: By making every Cosmos monster submit to him one by one over centuries, Alrund was able to take their secrets from them.

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As Asi, Alrund joins Inga Rune-Eyes and Kaya to hunt a dangerous monster that proves to be Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: This turned out to be none other than Vorinclex

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alrund instructs Kaya, Tyvar and the clan leaders that the Sword of the Realms must be given to Halvar to end the Doomskar.
timeline.quote: the Sword of the Realms must be given to Halvar

citation.text: "Alrund", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Birgi hired a dwarf skald to follow Toralf; Toralf threw him off a cliff and Birgi hired a sneakier skald.
timeline.quote: threw him off a cliff

citation.text: "Birgi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Niko Aris arrived, Birgi goaded Viking clans into conflict to show her their ways.
timeline.quote: Birgi goaded some Viking clans into conflict

citation.text: "Birgi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaya is given use of Cosima's longboat to find Vorinclex but is steered to Gnottvold to find Tibalt.
timeline.quote: but was steered towards Gnottvold to find Tibalt instead.

citation.text: "Cosima", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cosima fights the invading hordes in the Doomskar and helps Kaya cross enemy armies to deliver the Sword of the Realms to Halvar.
timeline.quote: She helped Kaya to cross the ranks of enemy armies so that the planeswalker could deliver the Sword of the Realms to Halvar .

citation.text: "Cosima", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cosima confronts Varragoth, noting he had no wings before, and tells Kaya she was on her boat.
timeline.quote: the goddess noted that the demon previously had had no wings

citation.text: "Cosima", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Kaldheim's inhabitants burn the World Tree to deny Phyrexia access, but Realmbreaker creates new Omenpaths.
timeline.quote: Kaldheim's inhabitants burned the World Tree to deny Phyrexia access to it

citation.text: "Cosmos", section "Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaito recruited Tyvar on Kaldheim, who insisted on bringing Niko.
timeline.quote: Kaito recruited Tyvar Kell on Kaldheim

citation.text: "Duskmourn Rescue Mission", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Esika and Tergrid come into being when Alrund uses runic magic to commune with the World Tree.
timeline.quote: Esika and her sister Tergrid came into being when Alrund used runic magic to commune with the World Tree .

citation.text: "Esika", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion Tree forces its way into the Cosmos and disorients Esika.
timeline.quote: Esika became disoriented, losing her connection to the Cosmos and her ability to guide herself through its vast expanse.

citation.text: "Esika", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Esika turns to Inga Rune-Eyes, who charts safe routes for her chariot.
timeline.quote: Inga charts the safest routes for Esika's chariot

citation.text: "Esika", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halvar wields Galdrimel against the Einir and splits the elf race into wood elves and shadow elves.
timeline.quote: Halvar used it to split the elf race in half

citation.text: "Halvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tibalt steals the Sword of the Realms before Koll can give it to Halvar.
timeline.quote: before it was stolen by the planeswalker Tibalt

citation.text: "Halvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With the Omenpaths open during the Doomskar, Harald marches to invade the other realms.
timeline.quote: Harald marched with his army to invade the other realms

citation.text: "Harald", section "Tibalt's machinations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Harald and Tyvar lead the defense of all ten realms of Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: Harald and his brother led the defense of all ten realms of Kaldheim

citation.text: "Harald", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vorinclex steals a fragment of the World Tree's essence, which becomes the Phyrexian Invasion Tree and disrupts Esika's navigation of the Cosmos.
timeline.quote: Esika lost her ability to navigate the vast, interplanar pathways that make up the Cosmos

citation.text: "Inga Rune-Eyes", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Esika seeks Inga's aid, and Inga's vision lets Esika's chariot cross the disrupted Cosmos.
timeline.quote: With Inga’s guidance, Esika’s chariot is now able to traverse the disrupted Cosmos

citation.text: "Inga Rune-Eyes", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Draugr encounter Lyana and Kit in the woods, and one seizes Kit and carries him off.
timeline.quote: one of the draugr seized Kit and carried him off

citation.text: "Kit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lathril and Lukya rescue Lyana and recover Kit, who is reunited with Lyana.
timeline.quote: she and her companion, Kit's sister Lukya stepped in to rescue Lyana and recover Kit

citation.text: "Kit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As a reward for Kit's rescue, Sarulf grants Lathril a bond between the elves of Skemfar and all wolves of Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: As a reward for Kit's rescue, Sarulf granted Lathril a bond

citation.text: "Kit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Skoti overthrew the Einir gods and prohibited Koma from entering any realm.
timeline.quote: when the Skoti overthrew the Einir gods , they also prohibited the Cosmos Serpent they revered from entering any of the realms.

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fynn stabbed Koma, and the serpent's poisonous blood turned Fynn's blood to poison.
timeline.quote: it turned his blood to poison as well.

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koma was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion and killed by his rival Fynn.
timeline.quote: Koma was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion and killed by his rival Fynn .

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarulf gifts Lukya to Queen Lathril after Lathril's transformative ordeal.
timeline.quote: Lukya appeared as a gift from her sire, the Cosmos Wolf Sarulf

citation.text: "Lukya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukya accompanies Lathril in battles against draugrs and helps rescue the child Lyana from assailants.
timeline.quote: helping rescue the child Lyana from assailants

citation.text: "Lukya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukya meets Sarulf, who acknowledges her as a chosen child and grants additional blessings.
timeline.quote: she is acknowledged as one of his chosen children

citation.text: "Lukya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Other worlds face upheavals: the Silence of the Gods and fall of Xenagos on Theros, the Aether Revolt on Kaladesh, Orazca on Ixalan, and the War of the Gods on Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: the War of the Gods on Kaldheim

citation.text: "Mending Era", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko tries to stop a brawl between the Omenseekers and Kannah instigated by Birgi while Orhaft stays aboard xer ship.
